seo.title: Igloo Construction – Igloo Groupe | Corporate Profile – Algeria
seo.description: Igloo Construction – Igloo Groupe (SARL Igloo Yapi Construction) is an Algerian general contractor founded in 2018, delivering residential and mixed-use developments through integrated engineering, procurement and site operations.
seo.socialTitle: Igloo Construction | Igloo Groupe – Corporate Profile
seo.socialDescription: Igloo Construction – Igloo Groupe – Category 6 certified general contractor based in Algiers, Algeria.

content.heading: Integrated engineering and site execution teams.
content.body: Founded in 2018 and led by civil engineer Adem Talay, SARL Igloo Yapi Construction — also known as Igloo Construction, Igloo Bâtiment, and Igloo Groupe — operates from Bir Khadem, Algiers, specialising in residential and mixed-use developments across Algeria.
